customManagers.description: Container image field in Kubernetes pod specs inside Coder templates
CODER_INNER_IMAGE env var value in envbox templates
coder_parameter default values containing Docker images (fallback_image, devcontainer_builder, etc.)

Pinned CLI tool versions passed to templatefile() for coder/templates/*/scripts/install-*.sh.tftpl, marked with a same-line trailing '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment, mirroring Flux's image marker convention (https://fluxcd.io/flux/components/image/imageupdateautomations/#marking-images-for-update)
Fission chart and Dev Container CLI versions marked with a preceding Renovate comment
Fission CRD tag and immutable Git object pin
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=custom\.fission-git-tags depName=fission\/fission versioning=semver-coerced\r?\n  # Fission v(?<currentValue>\d+\.\d+\.\d+) tag, resolved to immutable Git object (?<currentDigest>[a-f0-9]{40})\.\r?\n  - https://github\.com/fission/fission/crds/v1\?ref=[a-f0-9]{40}

customManagers.description: Fission deployment CLI version and release-published SHA-256
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=custom\.fission-releases depName=fission\/fission versioning=semver-coerced\r?\n  FISSION_VERSION: v(?<currentValue>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\r?\n  FISSION_SHA256: (?<currentDigest>[a-f0-9]{64})

customManagers.description: Pinned K3s versions in System Upgrade Controller Plans

transformTemplates: {"releases": $map($filter($[draft = false and prerelease = false and $match(tag_name, /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)], function($release) { $type($release.assets[name = $join(["fission-", $release.tag_name, "-linux-amd64"])].digest) = "string" }), function($release) { {"version": $substringAfter($release.tag_name, "v"), "digest": $substringAfter($release.assets[name = $join(["fission-", $release.tag_name, "-linux-amd64"])].digest, "sha256:"), "releaseTimestamp": $release.published_at, "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/fission/fission", "changelogUrl": $release.html_url} })}
